panels.title: Endpoints requests RPS
panels.description: Application request histogram counters, one centrally stored series per service. Endpoint RPS grouped by service and action; no Pod multiplication.

panels.title: Total Incoming RPS (nginx_vts_server_requests_total)
panels.description:
Источник: API Gateway
  Metrics: nginx_vts_server_requests_total
  Показывает: общий внешний RPS на API Gateway.

panels.title: Gateway RPS vs Symfony RPS
panels.description: Compares external API Gateway RPS with application request RPS. Application metrics are scraped once per service from shared Redis; the two measurement points need not match exactly.

targets.expr:
sum by (layer) (
    label_replace(
      rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m]),
      "layer",
      "API Gateway incoming RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  ) or
  sum by (layer, service) (
    label_replace(
      rate(
        {
          __name__=~"(.+_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count)",
          job=~"application-(auth|catalog|cart)",service=~"${services:regex}",
          action="all"
        }[5m]
      ),
      "layer",
      "Symfony application RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  )

panels.title: web php fpm workers
panels.description: PHP-FPM worker and listen queue totals summed across the selected Pods for each service. Select one Pod to inspect only that Pod; HPA replica changes are included automatically.

panels.title: Errors API Gateway (процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.)
panels.description:
Источник: API Gateway
  Metrics: nginx_vts_server_requests_total

  100 *
  (
    (
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]))
      or vector(0)
    )
    /
    clamp_min(
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m])),
      0.000000001
    )
  )

  Показывает: процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.
  Labels: none
  Unit: percent (0-100)
  Visualization: Stat или Gauge
  Ограничения: это gateway error %, не Symfony application error %. Для Symfony сейчас нет 5xx metrics.

targets.expr:
100 *
  (
    (
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]))
      or vector(0)
    )
    /
    clamp_min(
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m])),
      0.000000001
    )
  )
targets.legendFormat: процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.

panels.title: Latency P50 / P95 / P99
panels.description: Application request duration histogram from the shared service metrics. P50, P95 and P99 across selected services.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
    histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service) (rate({__name__=~".+_request_durations_histogram_seconds_bucket", job=~"application-(auth|catalog|cart)",service=~"${services:regex}", action="all"}[5m]))),
    "quantile", "p50%", "__name__", ".*"
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service) (rate({__name__=~".+_request_durations_histogram_seconds_bucket", job=~"application-(auth|catalog|cart)",service=~"${services:regex}", action="all"}[5m]))),
    "quantile", "p95%", "__name__", ".*"
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service) (rate({__name__=~".+_request_durations_histogram_seconds_bucket", job=~"application-(auth|catalog|cart)",service=~"${services:regex}", action="all"}[5m]))),
    "quantile", "p99%", "__name__", ".*"
  )

panels.title: Latency By Endpoint
panels.description: P95 application request duration by service and endpoint action, based on shared service histogram buckets.

panels.description: Overall CPU busy percentage (averaged across all cores)

panels.description: System load over all CPU cores together

panels.description: Percentage of swap space currently used by the system

panels.description: Used Root FS

panels.description: Real RAM usage excluding cache and reclaimable memory

panels.description: CPU time spent busy vs idle, split by activity type

panels.description: RAM and swap usage overview, including caches

panels.title: Disk Space Used Basic
panels.description: Percentage of filesystem space used for each mounted device

targets.expr: ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{node="$nodeInstance", job="node-exporter", device!~'rootfs'} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{node="$nodeInstance", job="node-exporter", device!~'rootfs'}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{node="$nodeInstance", job="node-exporter", device!~'rootfs'}) * 100

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time usage split by state, normalized across all CPU cores

matcher.options: Idle - Waiting for something to happen
Iowait - Waiting for I/O to complete
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode
Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment
System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode

targets.legendFormat: System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode
Iowait - Waiting for I/O to complete
Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment
Idle - Waiting for something to happen

targets.expr: sum by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_guest_seconds_total{node="$nodeInstance",job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval])) / on(instance) group_left sum by (instance)((rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{node="$nodeInstance",job="node-exporter"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Physical memory and swap breakdown on the selected node. The hardware corruption series requires node_memory_HardwareCorrupted_bytes from node-exporter; it may be absent on some hosts.

matcher.options: Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

targets.legendFormat: Apps - Memory used by user-space applications
PageTables - Memory used to map between virtual and physical memory addresses
SwapCache - Memory that keeps track of pages that have been fetched from swap but not yet been modified
Slab - Memory used by the kernel to cache data structures for its own use (caches like inode, dentry, etc)
Cache - Parked file data (file content) cache
Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

panels.title: Network Traffic
panels.description: Incoming and outgoing network traffic per interface

panels.title: Network Saturation
panels.description: Per-interface traffic divided by interface speed. Requires node_network_speed_bytes from node-exporter; interfaces without a reported speed do not produce this series.

panels.title: Disk IOps
panels.description: Disk I/O operations per second for each device

panels.title: Disk Throughput
panels.description: Disk I/O throughput per device

panels.title: Filesystem Space Available
panels.description: Amount of available disk space per mounted filesystem, excluding rootfs. Based on block availability to non-root users

panels.title: Filesystem Used
panels.description: Disk usage (used = total - available) per mountpoint

panels.title: Disk I/O Utilization
panels.description: Percentage of time the disk was actively processing I/O operations

panels.title: Pressure Stall Information
panels.description: Node pressure stall information. IRQ full pressure requires node_pressure_irq_stalled_seconds_total from the kernel and node-exporter; if unavailable, enable kernel IRQ PSI support and its exporter collector.

panels.title: Approx Avg Execution Time Per Tuple Operation
panels.description: Approximate active SQL time per tuple operation. Requires pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total and tuple counters from each PostgreSQL exporter; if active_time is absent, enable a compatible PostgreSQL exporter collector or custom query.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance, datname) (
    rate(pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m])
  )
  /
  clamp_min(
    sum by (instance, datname) (
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_inserted{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_updated{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_deleted{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_fetched{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m])
    ),
    0.000000001
  )

panels.title: Tuple Operations RPS
panels.description: Показывает RPS нагрузки по tuple operations: insert/update/delete/fetch/return.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_inserted{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m]), "operation", "inserted", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_updated{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m]), "operation", "updated", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_deleted{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m]), "operation", "deleted", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_fetched{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m]), "operation", "fetched", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_returned{job="postgres",instance=~`${dbInstances:regex}`, datname=~`${dbNames:regex}`}[5m]), "operation", "returned", "__name__", ".*")
  )

panels.title: Top 15 Pods by CPU (all namespaces)
panels.description: CPU usage in cores across all Kubernetes namespaces, including monitoring and system Pods. This panel is independent of the namespace and service filters.

panels.title: Memory usage / limit by service
panels.description: Ratio of summed cAdvisor container memory usage to summed configured memory limits across all observed Pods of each selected service (HTTP, worker and gRPC). Only containers with a positive memory limit are counted. Independent of the Pod filter.

targets.expr: sum by (label_service) ((container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"} and on(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0)) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_service) kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace",label_service=~"${services:regex}"}) / sum by (label_service) (((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0) and on(namespace,pod,container) container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_service) kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace",label_service=~"${services:regex}"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory usage / limit by Pod (all namespaces)
panels.description: Ratio of cAdvisor container memory usage to configured memory limits for each Pod, including monitoring/Grafana. Only containers with a positive memory limit are counted. Independent of namespace, service and Pod filters.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace,pod) (container_memory_usage_bytes{container!="",container!="POD"} and on(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0)) / sum by (namespace,pod) ((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0) and on(namespace,pod,container) container_memory_usage_bytes{container!="",container!="POD"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory usage / limit by service and container
panels.description: Ratio of cAdvisor container memory usage to configured memory limits, aggregated across Pods by application service and container type. Only containers with a positive memory limit are counted.

targets.expr: sum by (label_service, container) ((container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"} and on(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0)) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_service) kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace",label_service=~"${services:regex}"}) / sum by (label_service, container) (((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"} > 0) and on(namespace,pod,container) container_memory_usage_bytes{namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_service) kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace",label_service=~"${services:regex}"}) * 100
